# Diagnostic codes: ui area

Codes `UI-<TOPIC>-<NNN>` emitted by `src/core/src/ui/` (owner: DISPATCH,
`openspec/changes/m2-interactive-editing/design.md` D1/D2). Conventions and
the renderings are described in [../codes.md](../codes.md).

The table below is generated from `src/core/src/ui/codes.cpp`:

```sh
hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=ui
```

The unit test `each area's code table matches its document and prefix`
fails when the two disagree.

<!-- BEGIN DIAGNOSTIC CODES (generated by `hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=ui`) -->
| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `UI-CLIENT-001` | error | A window type (client) name is unknown, ambiguous or hidden; the valid window types are listed. |
| `UI-CLIENT-002` | error | The command needs an optional module that is not available yet (`netlist` until M12, `wind3d` until M10, `rsim`, `ext2spice` options other than `scale` until M7). |
| `UI-DISPATCH-001` | error | The command word is an ambiguous abbreviation (`That command abbreviation is ambiguous.`); nothing was run. |
| `UI-HISTORY-001` | error | A command-history expansion (`!...`, `^old^new`) names no matching event or word. |
| `UI-INTERRUPT-001` | warning | The command was interrupted (`[Interrupted]`). |
| `UI-KEY-001` | error | A key or button has no macro in the current table (`Unknown macro or short command: 'K'`). |
| `UI-LOG-001` | error | `logcommands` cannot start or change the command log (already open, cannot be created, or none open). |
| `UI-MACRO-001` | error | A macro key name cannot be parsed (`Unrecognized macro name K`). |
| `UI-MACRO-002` | error | `macro` cannot find the macro table of the window or name it was given; the known tables are listed. |
| `UI-PARSE-001` | warning | A command line has an unmatched quote; parsing continues as if it were closed at the end. |
| `UI-REPORT-001` | info | A dispatch, macro or tool command prints a note (Magic's TxPrintf text). |
| `UI-SOURCE-001` | error | `source` cannot read the script file (`Couldn't read from FILE.`). |
| `UI-STACK-001` | error | A box or edit stack command found no stack, an empty stack or no cell to push; the script error is raised. |
| `UI-SUSPEND-001` | error | `resumeall` was called without a matching `suspendall` (`resume called without suspend`). |
| `UI-TOOL-001` | error | A tool cannot be registered: ten tools exist already (`no space in button handler`). |
| `UI-USAGE-001` | error | A dispatch, macro, tool or script-helper command was given the wrong number or form of arguments; the usage is printed. |
<!-- END DIAGNOSTIC CODES -->
